reviews.review: I better be a shareholder of Bohemia Interactive at this point.
Not a big fan, got bored after a few hours

ArmA is a lifestyle.

This game goes above and beyond to provide an experience I've never had in any other military-related game.

It puts Battlefield to shame.

ArmA is slower paced than most games, but the wide variety of gamemodes can change the pace. Having a lot of patience helps.

I have watched as my friends die around me
I have shot and killed people on my team because I thought they were threats
I have lived through armageddon,
crawled through whole cities,
hidden in bodies to stay alive,
survived ordinance strikes only to be shot by my team,
trucked miles and miles through hell just for one squadmate,
I have been the hunter and the hunted,
followed orders and disobeyed them,
been stripped of my gear at gunpoint,
...

This game and it's predecessors are the reason I got into PC gaming

Don't let my hours confuse you. On separate accounts I've racked up at least 1,000 hours in the franchise.

This is where Battlegrounds started, and where DayZ continues through the masterful modding community.

This is ArmA 3.

----

The only problems I have with the game is the cost. DLCs cost almost as much as the game. I would wait for a sale or maybe a bundle on HumbleBundle.

It's older, but still regularly supported (new DLCs planned into Q1 2018)

It can run like crap if you don't have at least an i3 6100, but even then I would try for an i5. The reason is because of the AI. They're smart when opposing you, but dumb as hell when you're ordering them around.

The people of this game can either be laid back or completely serious and harsh.

It's ridiculous how much time you can spend doing one thing. I've sat for hours watching one place with a sniper rifle. Thank god I had a spotter to talk to.

This game is really social, too. If you're a lone wolf, you can expect to be outgunned a lot. This can be a problem if you play by yourself a lot. I'd suggest getting at least one friend to get the game as well.

Thanks for reading if you did.

LOVE this game, this is the best game i have. The apex dlc is also good, it is great without any dlc but for the low price of the dlc it is worth a purchase.

EDIT:This game was great before i had 100 hours in it and to be honest it is still the best game i have.
quite frankly the best tactical military simulation out there.
